bayts.text: The Lord of the heaven and the earth has answered me with that which has risen high; and from Him He has led to me the summits — and how excellent is what (He) has allotted to me!
He has saved me from the enemies: whoever transgressed has not made his way toward me; He has tamed for me whoever was hostile, and He has been for me and has magnified (me).
The Everlasting (al-Bāqī), the Generous, has extended to me the whole of what I desired from Him — and gratitude to Him is what I desire — and He has thrust away whoever grew arrogant.
The Everlasting, the Ancient (al-Qadīm), has honoured me in that I am the servant, the Khadīm (the Servant); and He has bestowed on me that which endures, (me) holding fast to His rope.
To Him (goes) my discourse, (I being) thankful; and He has made good (my) acts of thanks, (making me) a servant most thankful, remembering; and through my abiding (in life) He has preserved (me).
To me He has led His immense favour, and has led to me the well-strung pearl; and He has been for me with (a gift) immense, and to me He has led graces.
He has answered me through the Most Sublime (Name), in prose and in verse; He has thrust away whoever is full of arrogance, and He never ceases to be Bestower of grace.
He is the God and the Self-Sufficient (aṣ-Ṣamad), Who raises the heaven without pillars; and He has already spared me grief, and He has been for me and has honoured (me).
He has taken away what He did not approve for me, through the service of the Preferred One (al-Mufaḍḍal, the Prophet); and He has been for me with the best, and has led to me munificence.

He has taught me the Wise Remembrance (adh-Dhikr al-Ḥakīm); toward Himself the Wise (al-Ḥakīm) has led me; He has made (things) easy for me — and what an excellent Wise One! — He has instructed me and made (me) understand.
My Lord has softened hearts for me; He has bestowed on me (His) favour as (pure) milk; He has led hearts to Him through me, and has kept for me what (He) has held hidden.
His sciences have guided my heart; He has brought to me aspirations that appeared, which have become with me a gift that guides whoever did not know.
My wrong has been effaced without trace; I have passed beyond the trial of the Spider (its frail webs, Sūrat al-ʿAnkabūt); my life spends its noon and its night (as) a ladder toward the Gardens.
An Everlasting One who leads fair things to me has made me master of the light of the tongue; and for me He has made the tongue upright, and to me He has led the well-established (Book).
Allah, the All-Aware (Al-Khabīr), has instructed me and has led to me the great reward; He has thrust my adversary into the oblivion of the past, He has guarded me and made (me) arbiter.
I have cast away what has drawn away from me, (for) Him Who has led to me length of arm (might); and for me He has illumined the natures, and He shows me no pain.
The Everlasting has called me toward His Garden rich in bounties; and from Him He has led bounties to me, and He has already taught my breast.
Allah, the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), has brought me back to my place of return with gratitude, for the service of the thankful servant, and for me He has made the natures good.
He has cleared me of the accusations, has bestowed on me what was hidden, has kept me from illusion, and for me has protected my life.
The blessing of al-Māḥī (Muḥammad), the Friend (of Allah), light of Rabīʿ al-Awwal, has driven away the fabricators of lies; and whoever refused him has been broken.
